founder.name: Jordan Reyes
founder.notes: 11 years in-house technical recruiter at 3 VC-backed startups before going independent 14 months ago. Bootstrap-funded, explicit: 'This stays bootstrapped - I'm not raising money to run a search firm, I'm reinvesting placement fees into hiring associate recruiters.' Solo delivery today; the founder's own calendar is the stated bottleneck, named unprompted during onboarding. 2026-09-29: stated directly during the second recurring check-in that he wants to narrow the beachhead's lower bound from ~50 employees to ~120+ employees (Series C-D) after two real, same-mechanism prospect declines at the sub-100-employee end of the current band (see risk_log ops-vantage-point-search-001) — steps 01/02/04 reopened, 05 flagged for re-confirmation only.

business_basics.one_liner: Retained executive search for VP/Director of Engineering hires at Series B-D venture-backed startups (roughly 50-500 employees) who've tried to fill the role through their own network or a generalist recruiter for 2-3+ months and struck out.
business_basics.business_type_notes: Retained executive search, project-based per engagement (not retainer, not hourly). Currently solo - founder personally executes 100% of delivery (sourcing, screening, client management) in addition to 100% of business development. No licensing requirement (retained permanent-placement search is not a licensed profession in the founder's operating states). Founder's own 11-year professional network is both the primary demand-generation channel and the delivery bottleneck.

risk_log.raised_by: ai-risk-analyst (via skills/risk/ai-risk-review, called from Step 19's own contract)
risk_log.description: First-pass draft of plan/19-calculate-the-coca.md stated COCA as an exact '$5,173' figure and the LTV:COCA ratios to a precision the underlying $100/hr placeholder founder-rate and untimed ~45-hour delivery-time estimate did not support (false precision, AI-risk failure mode 2). BLOCKED. Fixed by re-stating COCA as an honest range ($4,900-$5,400, ~$5,200) and rounding the ratios to one decimal place; re-ran the gate same session, PASS confirmed. This is the third consecutive round (following round 2's ShiftCover and round 3's SkyClaim) in which the AI-risk gate independently caught a false-precision finding at a downstream synthesized unit-economics figure - a recurring, structurally expected failure mode the gate continues to catch reliably, not a new bug.

Pivot signal: 2 of 2 pipeline prospects that reached the internal-budget-check stage in the 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-29 period and were below ~100 employees (Series B, #2 ~80 employees and #4 ~60 employees) declined citing inability to justify the 30% retained-search fee for a first senior hire without a formal external-spend process, vs. unrelated-reason losses for Series C/D prospects the same period (#3 competitive, #9 free VC-intro). Founder (Jordan) stated directly during the 2026-09-29 recurring check-in that he wants to narrow the beachhead's lower bound from Step 2's stated ~50-500 employees to roughly Series C-D / ~120+ employees, and stop spending BD time below that line. Recommended reopened steps: 01 (segment-1 size band), 02 (beachhead band), 04 (TAM recompute, cascades from 01/02), 05 (persona re-confirmation only — the existing Dana persona at ~130 employees already sits inside the proposed narrower band). Step 16 (pricing/fee-floor alternative) named as worth considering, not required. Would be resolved/re-baselined once steps 01/02/04/05 are re-run and the plan re-passes council review per agents/orchestrator.md's pivot protocol.
